<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/user/{name}/sshkey"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Reads ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the user through gohai, with the type, the SHA256 fingerprint, the comment and the options of each key. A user with no file has no keys. A user that the host does not have is not found.
